blocks.zh: Sample Valve Design  |  取樣閥設計
blocks.en: Sample Valve Design

blocks.zh: Valve types, dead volume, sanitary requirements, outlet configuration  |  閥門類型、死角體積、衛生要求、出口配置
blocks.en: Valve types, dead volume, sanitary requirements, outlet configuration

blocks.zh: 中文詮釋 & CDMO 應用解析
blocks.en: Commentary & CDMO Application Analysis

blocks.zh: 設計核心原則解析
blocks.en: Core Design Principles

blocks.zh: 取樣閥設計的核心邏輯：閥門本身不能成為污染源。ISPE 特別提到三個設計陷阱：
blocks.en: The core logic of sample valve design: the valve itself must not become a source of contamination. ISPE specifically highlights three design traps:

blocks.zh: 死角體積（Dead Volume）：閥座上游積存的水，是微生物滋生的溫床。每次取樣前必須充分沖洗以驅逐此積水。
blocks.en: Dead volume: Water trapped upstream of the valve seat is a breeding ground for microorganisms. The system must be flushed thoroughly before every sampling to displace this stagnant water.

blocks.zh: 出口積水：閥門關閉後，出口路徑中殘留的水（受表面張力維持）會接觸外界空氣，即使微生物污染的風險極高。
blocks.en: Outlet water retention: After the valve is closed, water remaining in the outlet path (held by surface tension) is exposed to ambient air, so the risk of microbial contamination is very high.

blocks.zh: 附加硬體：閥門後方的任何接頭、彎管、轉接器都是引入外源污染的潛在來源，應盡量精簡。
blocks.en: Add-on hardware: Any fitting, bend or adapter downstream of the valve is a potential entry point for extraneous contamination and should be kept to a minimum.

blocks.zh: 核心概念：衛生設計等級
blocks.en: Key Concept: Hygienic Design Grades

blocks.zh: 製藥用水系統中，衛生設計等級隨系統位置而提高：
blocks.en: In pharmaceutical water systems, the hygienic design grade increases with position in the system:

blocks.zh: 進料水 / 前處理 → 可採工業級閥門（化學取樣）
blocks.en: Feed water / pretreatment → industrial-grade valves acceptable (chemical sampling)

blocks.zh: 初級純化後段 → 衛生級連接推薦
blocks.en: Downstream of primary purification → sanitary connections recommended

blocks.zh: 最終純化後（PW/WFI 分配系統）→ 衛生設計強制要求
blocks.en: After final purification (PW/WFI distribution system) → hygienic design is mandatory

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務：閥門採購決策
blocks.en: CDMO Practice: Valve Purchasing Decisions

blocks.zh: 選購取樣閥時，應同時考量：（1）是否有效排水（outlet 朝下）；（2）把手材質（高溫熱水系統避免不鏽鋼導熱把手）；（3）是否支援酒精注入（sanitizable valve）。安裝前應實際測試出水口是否能讓常用取樣容器接觸到。
blocks.en: When selecting sample valves, consider all of the following: (1) effective drainage (outlet pointing downward); (2) handle material (avoid heat-conducting stainless steel handles in hot water systems); (3) whether the valve supports alcohol injection (sanitizable valve). Before installation, physically test whether the commonly used sample containers can reach the outlet.

blocks.zh: Valve Type Comparison Table  |  取樣閥類型比較表
blocks.en: Valve Type Comparison Table

blocks.zh: 出口配置與材質選擇重點
blocks.en: Key Points on Outlet Configuration and Material Selection

blocks.zh: 衛生夾頭（Tri-Clamp / Sanitary Clamp）
blocks.en: Sanitary Clamp (Tri-Clamp)

blocks.zh: 衛生夾頭是製藥分配系統的標準連接方式，提供：可拆卸清潔、無螺紋死角、快速組裝等優勢。微生物取樣閥應以此為標準連接形式。
blocks.en: The sanitary clamp is the standard connection method in pharmaceutical distribution systems. It offers easy disassembly for cleaning, no threaded dead legs and fast assembly. Microbial sample valves should use this as the standard connection type.

blocks.zh: 比喻：出口朝上如同積水漏斗
blocks.en: Analogy: An Upward-Facing Outlet Is a Water-Collecting Funnel

blocks.zh: 想像一個漏斗倒過來放——水不但不會流出，還會積在頸部。取樣閥出口朝上的設計，就是相同邏輯：閥門關閉後，殘留水無法靠重力排出，成為微生物溫床。正確設計應使出口朝下，確保自然排水。
blocks.en: Imagine a funnel turned upside down: the water does not run out, and instead pools in the neck. An upward-facing sample valve outlet works on the same principle: after the valve closes, residual water cannot drain by gravity and becomes a breeding ground for microorganisms. The correct design points the outlet downward to ensure natural drainage.

blocks.zh: 高溫系統特別注意
blocks.en: Special Attention for High-Temperature Systems

blocks.zh: WFI 系統通常維持 80°C 以上循環。不鏽鋼閥門把手在此溫度下觸摸危險。應改用耐高溫塑膠（如 PVDF、PEEK）把手材質。O-ring 密封也應確認材質相容性（推薦 EPDM 或 PTFE encapsulated）。
blocks.en: WFI systems are typically circulated at 80°C or above, at which temperature stainless steel valve handles are dangerous to touch. Use heat-resistant plastic handle materials instead (such as PVDF or PEEK). Confirm the material compatibility of O-ring seals as well (EPDM or PTFE-encapsulated recommended).

blocks.zh: CDMO 冷卻閥站設計建議
blocks.en: CDMO Cooling Valve Station Design Recommendations

blocks.zh: WFI / Pure Steam 取樣點應配備冷卻裝置（如蛇形冷卻管、板式熱交換器）。設備尺寸需足夠，且冷卻設備本身應定期滅菌，避免成為額外污染源。
blocks.en: WFI / pure steam sampling points should be equipped with a cooling device (such as a coil cooler or plate heat exchanger). The equipment must be adequately sized, and the cooling equipment itself should be sanitized regularly so that it does not become an additional source of contamination.

blocks.en: Sampling Techniques

blocks.zh: Representative sampling, container selection, aseptic technique, step-by-step procedure  |  代表性取樣、容器選擇、無菌技術、逐步程序
blocks.en: Representative sampling, container selection, aseptic technique, step-by-step procedure

blocks.zh: 中文詮釋 & 容器選擇關鍵點
blocks.en: Commentary & Key Points on Container Selection

blocks.zh: 代表性取樣的微生物挑戰
blocks.en: The Microbial Challenge of Representative Sampling

blocks.zh: 化學屬性（TOC、電導率）在水體中均勻分布，理論上在任何點取樣結果相同。但微生物與內毒素不均勻分布——它們附著在表面，尤其集中在管壁、閥門出口、接頭處形成的生物膜（biofilm）。
blocks.en: Chemical attributes (TOC, conductivity) are uniformly distributed in the water, so in theory any sampling point gives the same result. Microorganisms and endotoxin, however, are not uniformly distributed: they adhere to surfaces and concentrate especially in the biofilm that forms on pipe walls, valve outlets and joints.

blocks.zh: 這就是為什麼 FDA 要求從實際 POU 取樣：你在分配迴路中間取樣，得到的微生物數據不能代表製程設備實際用到的水質。
blocks.en: This is why FDA expects sampling at the actual POU: microbial data from a sample taken mid-loop in the distribution system cannot represent the water quality actually used by the process equipment.

blocks.zh: 容器材質選擇原則（三不一是）
blocks.en: Container Material Selection Principles (Three "Nots" and One "Must")

blocks.zh: 不添加（Non-additive）：不浸出被測物
blocks.en: Non-additive: does not leach the analyte

blocks.zh: 不反應（Non-reactive）：不與被測物發生化學反應
blocks.en: Non-reactive: does not react chemically with the analyte

blocks.zh: 不吸附（Non-absorptive）：不吸收被測物
blocks.en: Non-absorptive: does not absorb the analyte

blocks.zh: 是：能提供無菌密封機制
blocks.en: Must provide a means of aseptic sealing

blocks.zh: 常見錯誤 #1：容器混用
blocks.en: Common Error #1: Mixing Up Containers

blocks.zh: 用玻璃瓶做電導率取樣 → 矽酸鹽和鈉離子浸出 → 結果偏高
blocks.en: Glass bottle used for conductivity sampling → silicate and sodium ions leach out → result biased high

blocks.zh: 用可塑膠袋做內毒素取樣 → 疏水表面吸附內毒素 → 結果偏低（假陰性）
blocks.en: Flexible plastic bag used for endotoxin sampling → hydrophobic surface adsorbs endotoxin → result biased low (false negative)

blocks.zh: 用普通塑膠瓶做 TOC → 有機物浸出 → TOC 偏高，OOS 觸發調查
blocks.en: Ordinary plastic bottle used for TOC → organics leach out → TOC biased high, triggering an OOS investigation

blocks.zh: 用組織培養瓶做微生物取樣 → 表面促細胞黏附塗層可能促進細菌黏附增殖
blocks.en: Tissue culture flask used for microbial sampling → the cell-adhesion-promoting surface coating may encourage bacterial attachment and growth

blocks.zh: CO₂ 污染：電導率取樣的隱形殺手
blocks.en: CO₂ Contamination: The Hidden Enemy of Conductivity Sampling

blocks.zh: 大氣中的 CO₂ 溶入樣品水中形成碳酸（HCO₃⁻），提高電導率。即使快速裝滿容器也無法完全避免。這是為何離線電導率幾乎永遠高於在線讀數——不是系統變差，而是取樣過程引入的誤差。電導率趨勢管控應優先採用在線儀器。
blocks.en: Atmospheric CO₂ dissolves into the sample water to form carbonic acid (HCO₃⁻), which raises conductivity. Even filling the container quickly cannot fully prevent this. This is why offline conductivity is almost always higher than the online reading: it does not mean the system has deteriorated, but that the sampling process introduces error. Online instruments should be the first choice for conductivity trend control.

blocks.zh: 中文詮釋 & 常見錯誤分析
blocks.en: Commentary & Common Error Analysis

blocks.zh: 2.5.3 軟管的污染風險管理
blocks.en: 2.5.3 Managing the Contamination Risk of Hoses

blocks.zh: 常見錯誤 #2：軟管未拆除留置
blocks.en: Common Error #2: Leaving the Hose in Place

blocks.zh: 軟管（hose）安裝後若不立即拆除，其內部殘水在室溫下數小時內即可形成明顯生物膜。下次取樣時，前面的沖洗量可能不足以驅逐軟管內部生長的細菌，導致取樣結果偏高，觸發 OOS 調查。
blocks.en: If a hose is not removed immediately after installation, the residual water inside it can form noticeable biofilm within a few hours at room temperature. At the next sampling, the preceding flush may not be enough to displace the bacteria growing inside the hose, giving a high result and triggering an OOS investigation.

blocks.zh: 正確做法：取樣前安裝，取樣後立即拆除，並通過驗證建立最長可留置時間（qualified period）。
blocks.en: Correct practice: Install the hose before sampling and remove it immediately afterwards, and establish through validation the maximum time it may remain in place (qualified period).

blocks.zh: 2.5.4 人員訓練是數據品質的根本
blocks.en: 2.5.4 Personnel Training Is the Foundation of Data Quality

blocks.zh: 比喻：取樣員是系統的最後一道分析儀器
blocks.en: Analogy: The Sampler Is the System's Last Analytical Instrument

blocks.zh: 再好的 WFI 系統，如果取樣員不按程序執行，數據就是有缺陷的。取樣員的手法差異（沖洗時間、容器選擇、蓋子開啟方式），往往是水質數據變異的最大來源——而這一點很容易被誤判為系統問題。
blocks.en: However good the WFI system is, if the sampler does not follow the procedure, the data are flawed. Differences in sampler technique (flush time, container choice, how the cap is opened) are often the largest source of variability in water quality data, and this is easily misjudged as a system problem.

blocks.zh: 取樣順序記憶法
blocks.en: Memory Aid for Sampling Order

blocks.zh: 正確順序：化學先，微生物後
blocks.en: Correct order: chemical first, microbial last

blocks.zh: 電導率（Conductivity）
blocks.en: Conductivity

blocks.zh: 金屬離子 / 其他化學屬性
blocks.en: Metal ions / other chemical attributes

blocks.zh: 微生物（Bioburden）——IPA 消毒後再取
blocks.en: Microbial (bioburden): sample after IPA disinfection

blocks.zh: 細菌內毒素（Endotoxin）——最後取
blocks.en: Bacterial endotoxin: sample last

blocks.zh: 原因：IPA 消毒噴灑後，若在 IPA 前取 TOC，則 IPA 殘留會拉高 TOC 結果。
blocks.en: Reason: if IPA is sprayed and TOC is then sampled after the IPA, IPA residue will raise the TOC result.

blocks.zh: 常見錯誤 #3：QC 取樣複製製程操作
blocks.en: Common Error #3: QC Sampling That Replicates Process Operations

blocks.zh: QC 取樣的目的是複製製程的實際用水方式，而非「取到最乾淨的水」。若製程使用 30 秒 8 fps 沖洗，QC 取樣也必須這樣沖洗。若製程不噴 IPA，取樣時也不噴。任何偏差都會讓 QC 數據失去代表性。
blocks.en: The purpose of QC sampling is to replicate how the process actually uses the water, not to "obtain the cleanest water". If the process uses a 30-second flush at 8 fps, QC sampling must flush the same way. If the process does not spray IPA, neither should the sampler. Any deviation makes the QC data unrepresentative.

blocks.zh: 取樣後閥門後處理
blocks.en: Post-Sampling Valve Treatment

blocks.zh: 取樣後出口殘水是微生物生長的溫床（2.5.9）。正確做法：
blocks.en: Water remaining in the outlet after sampling is a breeding ground for microorganisms (2.5.9). Correct practices:

blocks.zh: 噴酒精讓其揮發，驅逐殘水
blocks.en: Spray alcohol and let it evaporate to drive out the residual water

blocks.zh: 使用含消毒劑注入口的特殊閥門，封存消毒劑
blocks.en: Use a special valve with a sanitant injection port to seal in the sanitant

blocks.zh: 使用無菌壓縮空氣吹乾出口（封閉系統 POU）
blocks.en: Blow the outlet dry with sterile compressed air (closed-system POU)

blocks.zh: 禁止蓋上潮濕的閥門蓋：積水 + 密封 = 細菌滋生
blocks.en: Do not put a wet cap on the valve: standing water + a seal = bacterial growth

blocks.zh: 思考練習 4
blocks.en: Thinking Exercise 4

blocks.zh: 依照 ISPE 建議，取樣員若先噴 IPA，再取 TOC 樣品，可能發生什麼後果？
blocks.en: According to ISPE recommendations, what could happen if the sampler sprays IPA first and then takes the TOC sample?

blocks.zh: 軟管取樣後未立即拆除，放置一夜後再取樣，應如何調整沖洗程序？有沒有「幾乎不可能合格」的情形？
blocks.en: If a hose is not removed after sampling and is left overnight before the next sampling, how should the flush procedure be adjusted? Are there situations where passing is nearly impossible?

blocks.zh: 你的工廠目前的 SOP 是否規定了正確的取樣順序（化學先、微生物後）？如果沒有，你會如何提出改善建議？
blocks.en: Does your site's current SOP specify the correct sampling order (chemical first, microbial last)? If not, how would you propose an improvement?

blocks.zh: Handling of Samples  |  樣品處理
blocks.en: Handling of Samples

blocks.zh: Hold times, transport temperature, storage, chain of custody  |  保存時限、運輸溫度、儲存條件、樣品監管鏈
blocks.en: Hold times, transport temperature, storage, chain of custody

blocks.zh: 中文詮釋 & 實驗室排程影響
blocks.en: Commentary & Impact of Laboratory Scheduling

blocks.zh: 離線分析的七個污染窗口
blocks.en: Seven Contamination Windows in Offline Analysis

blocks.zh: ISPE 列出七個離線取樣的污染風險點。每一個都是實驗室 QC 數據品質的潛在漏洞：
blocks.en: ISPE lists seven contamination risk points in offline sampling. Each is a potential weakness in laboratory QC data quality:

blocks.zh: 污染窗口分析（CDMO 視角）
blocks.en: Contamination Window Analysis (CDMO Perspective)

blocks.zh: 窗口 1–3：取樣現場——人員技術、容器操作、出口接觸
blocks.en: Windows 1-3: At the sampling site: personnel technique, container handling, outlet contact

blocks.zh: 窗口 4–5：運輸與儲存——溫度控制、時限管理
blocks.en: Windows 4-5: Transport and storage: temperature control, hold time management

blocks.zh: 窗口 6–7：實驗室開封操作、複測處理
blocks.en: Windows 6-7: Opening the sample in the laboratory, handling of retests

blocks.zh: 這就是為何在線/在位儀器（inline/online）是最優選：消除 7 個窗口全部。
blocks.en: This is why inline/online instruments are the best choice: they eliminate all seven windows.

blocks.zh: 運輸溫度控制原則
blocks.en: Principles of Transport Temperature Control

blocks.zh: 冰水運輸的禁忌
blocks.en: The Prohibition on Ice-Water Transport

blocks.zh: ISPE 明確指出：禁用冰水（ice and water）混合物作為冷卻劑，因融化冰水可能滲入密封不完全的容器。應改用無水冷袋（waterless cold packs）加隔熱箱。同時，避免超低溫冷劑（如乾冰），防止樣品結凍。
blocks.en: ISPE states explicitly that ice and water mixtures must not be used as coolant, because melted ice water can seep into containers that are not fully sealed. Use waterless cold packs in an insulated box instead. Also avoid ultra-low-temperature coolants (such as dry ice) so that the sample does not freeze.

blocks.zh: CDMO 實驗室排程建議
blocks.en: CDMO Laboratory Scheduling Recommendations

blocks.zh: 電導率：盡快檢測（不建議冷藏），當日上午取樣，當日上午分析
blocks.en: Conductivity: Test as soon as possible (refrigeration not recommended); sample in the morning and analyze the same morning

blocks.zh: TOC：使用認證低 TOC 容器，最多 2-3 天緩衝；但務必在期限內安排
blocks.en: TOC: Use certified low-TOC containers, with a buffer of 2-3 days at most; but be sure to schedule within the time limit

blocks.zh: 微生物：2 小時內開始培養；否則立即冷藏（2~8°C），並記錄冷藏起始時間
blocks.en: Microbial: Start incubation within 2 hours; otherwise refrigerate immediately (2-8°C) and record the time refrigeration started

blocks.zh: 內毒素：同微生物保存條件，參考 USP <1231>
blocks.en: Endotoxin: Same storage conditions as microbial; refer to USP <1231>

blocks.zh: 實際上，多屬性取樣日需要安排「取樣到實驗室」的時程，使最嚴格的項目（微生物）能在 2 小時內處理。
blocks.en: In practice, on a day with multi-attribute sampling, the "sampling to laboratory" timeline must be planned so that the most stringent item (microbial) can be processed within 2 hours.

blocks.zh: 常見錯誤 #4：超時才送實驗室
blocks.en: Common Error #4: Delivering Samples to the Laboratory Too Late

blocks.zh: 最常見的偏差原因之一：取樣後樣品在現場滯留過久（等待其他取樣點、等待運輸人員）。這段時間的溫度、時間未被記錄，樣品鏈（chain of custody）出現空白，後續 OOS 調查時無法重建樣品狀態。
blocks.en: One of the most common causes of deviations is samples sitting at the site too long after sampling (waiting for other sampling points or for the transport person). The temperature and time during this period are not recorded, leaving a gap in the chain of custody, so the sample status cannot be reconstructed in a later OOS investigation.

blocks.zh: 解決方案：在取樣 SOP 中規定最長樣品滯留時間，並在容器上貼取樣時間標籤，實驗室接收時強制核對。
blocks.en: Solution: Specify the maximum sample holding time at the site in the sampling SOP, label each container with the sampling time, and make the laboratory verify it on receipt.

blocks.zh: 電導率不冷藏的理由
blocks.en: Why Conductivity Samples Are Not Refrigerated

blocks.zh: 為何電導率樣品「不冷藏」反而較好？
blocks.en: Why is it actually better not to refrigerate conductivity samples?

blocks.zh: USP <645> Stage 2 電導率測試需要在特定溫度（通常 25°C）進行。若樣品從 2~8°C 冰箱取出，需等待回溫至室溫才能開始測試——增加等待時間，也增加更多 CO₂ 吸收機會。因此，對電導率測試而言，在室溫下盡快測試，反而比冷藏後回溫更合理。
blocks.en: The USP <645> Stage 2 conductivity test must be performed at a specified temperature (usually 25°C). A sample taken out of a 2-8°C refrigerator has to wait to warm up to room temperature before testing can start, which adds waiting time and more opportunity for CO₂ absorption. For conductivity, testing at room temperature as soon as possible is therefore more reasonable than testing after refrigeration and warm-up.

blocks.zh: 思考練習 5
blocks.en: Thinking Exercise 5

blocks.zh: 你的工廠距離合約實驗室需要 4 小時車程。微生物樣品取樣後，應立即採取什麼措施？需要在運輸文件上記錄哪些信息？
blocks.en: Your site is a 4-hour drive from the contract laboratory. What should be done immediately after microbial sampling? What information needs to be recorded on the transport documents?

blocks.zh: TOC 樣品若使用可重複使用的玻璃瓶（非認證低 TOC），建議在多少小時內完成分析？
blocks.en: If TOC samples are collected in reusable glass bottles (not certified low-TOC), within how many hours should analysis be completed?

blocks.zh: 為什麼電導率取樣時容器要盡量裝滿（fill to brim）？
blocks.en: Why should the container be filled as full as possible (fill to brim) for conductivity sampling?

blocks.zh: Sample Hold Time Reference Table  |  樣品保存時限參考表
blocks.en: Sample Hold Time Reference Table

blocks.zh: 蓋子設計與無菌操作
blocks.en: Cap Design and Aseptic Handling

blocks.zh: 「不接觸密封面」原則
blocks.en: The "Do Not Touch the Sealing Surface" Principle

blocks.zh: 無論手套是否酒精消毒，手指都不應觸碰容器蓋子的密封面（sealing surface）。微生物取樣時，手套僅是「清潔」而非「無菌」。應選擇設計上可以在不觸碰密封面的情況下開蓋的容器，例如翻蓋式、螺旋蓋側握設計等。
blocks.en: Whether or not the gloves have been sprayed with alcohol, fingers should never touch the sealing surface of the container cap. In microbial sampling, gloves are only "clean", not "sterile". Choose containers designed so that the cap can be opened without touching the sealing surface, such as flip-top caps or screw caps designed for side gripping.

blocks.zh: 樣品監管鏈（Chain of Custody）
blocks.en: Chain of Custody

blocks.zh: CoC 的必要記錄項目
blocks.en: Required CoC Records

blocks.zh: 取樣地點 / 樣品 ID
blocks.en: Sampling location / sample ID

blocks.zh: 取樣日期與時間（精確到分鐘）
blocks.en: Sampling date and time (to the minute)

blocks.zh: 取樣人員姓名
blocks.en: Name of the sampler

blocks.zh: 裝箱時間與溫度記錄
blocks.en: Packing time and temperature record

blocks.zh: 冷鏈驗證（溫度計讀數或電子溫度記錄）
blocks.en: Cold chain verification (thermometer reading or electronic temperature record)

blocks.zh: 實驗室簽收時間與簽收人
blocks.en: Laboratory receipt time and name of the person receiving

blocks.zh: 若需複測：每次開封時間與處理人
blocks.en: If retesting is needed: time of each opening and the person handling it

blocks.zh: 法規風險：超時保存的後果
blocks.en: Regulatory Risk: Consequences of Exceeding Hold Times

blocks.zh: 微生物保存時間超過 USP <1231> 規定 → OOS 結果不可靠，調查結論可能被否定
blocks.en: Microbial hold time exceeds that specified in USP <1231> → OOS result is unreliable and the investigation conclusion may be rejected

blocks.zh: Chain of custody 缺失 → 法規檢查時無法確認樣品完整性，可能觸發 483 observation
blocks.en: Chain of custody missing → sample integrity cannot be confirmed during an inspection, which may trigger a 483 observation

blocks.zh: 電導率樣品冷藏後直接測試（未回溫）→ Stage 2 溫度條件不符，數據無效
blocks.en: Conductivity sample tested directly after refrigeration (without warming up) → Stage 2 temperature condition not met, data invalid

blocks.zh: 內毒素樣品塑膠容器長時間儲存 → 內毒素吸附流失 → 假陰性風險
blocks.en: Endotoxin sample stored in a plastic container for a long time → endotoxin lost by adsorption → risk of false negative

blocks.zh: 思考練習 6
blocks.en: Thinking Exercise 6

blocks.zh: 你的 WFI POU 取樣後，樣品在現場等待 3 小時才送到實驗室（室溫 25°C）。哪些屬性的結果可能受到影響？你會如何進行風險評估？
blocks.en: After sampling your WFI POU, the sample waits 3 hours at the site (room temperature 25°C) before reaching the laboratory. Which attributes may be affected? How would you perform the risk assessment?

blocks.zh: OOS 調查中，調查員想確認微生物超標是否來自取樣問題而非系統問題，Chain of Custody 記錄需要提供哪些關鍵信息？
blocks.en: In an OOS investigation, the investigator wants to confirm whether a microbial excursion came from the sampling rather than the system. What key information must the chain of custody records provide?

blocks.zh: 如何在你的工廠建立一個確保 CoC 完整的樣品標籤系統？
blocks.en: How would you set up a sample labeling system at your site that ensures a complete CoC?

blocks.zh: Parametric (Real Time) Release  |  參數式即時放行
blocks.en: Parametric (Real Time) Release

blocks.zh: Online monitoring, PAT, real-time release, microbial limitations, rapid methods  |  在線監控、PAT、即時放行、微生物限制、快速方法
blocks.en: Online monitoring, PAT, real-time release, microbial limitations, rapid methods

blocks.zh: 中文詮釋 & 即時放行策略分析
blocks.en: Commentary & Real-Time Release Strategy Analysis

blocks.zh: 參數式放行的核心邏輯
blocks.en: Core Logic of Parametric Release

blocks.zh: 即時放行（RTR）的本質
blocks.en: The Essence of Real-Time Release (RTR)

blocks.zh: 傳統做法：取樣 → 送實驗室 → 等待結果（數小時到數天）→ 根據結果放行用水。RTR 目標：用連續在線測量取代離線取樣測試，即測即知，即時放行。
blocks.en: Traditional approach: sample → send to laboratory → wait for results (hours to days) → release the water based on the results. RTR aims to replace offline sampling and testing with continuous online measurement: measure and know immediately, and release in real time.

blocks.zh: 關鍵前提：在線測量數據必須與 POU 的離線結果等效，且需要驗證。這個等效性是 USP 允許 RTR 的核心條件。
blocks.en: Key prerequisite: the online measurement data must be equivalent to the offline results at the POU, and this must be validated. This equivalence is the core condition under which USP allows RTR.

blocks.zh: 化學屬性 vs. 微生物屬性的根本差異
blocks.en: The Fundamental Difference Between Chemical and Microbial Attributes

blocks.zh: 比喻：均勻湯 vs. 黏土塊
blocks.en: Analogy: Uniform Soup vs. Clay Lumps

blocks.zh: TOC 和電導率在水中如同均勻攪拌的湯——任何一瓢取出的成分都相同。因此，在迴路任何一點監測，結果都能代表 POU 水質。
blocks.en: TOC and conductivity in water are like a well-stirred soup: every spoonful has the same composition. Monitoring at any point in the loop therefore gives results representative of the POU water quality.

blocks.zh: 微生物和內毒素則如同水中漂浮的黏土塊（biofilm 碎片）——不均勻分布，聚集在局部。在迴路中間點的在線儀器，根本無法代表 POU 出口閥附近的真實微生物狀態。
blocks.en: Microorganisms and endotoxin are like clay lumps (biofilm fragments) floating in the water: they are unevenly distributed and cluster locally. An online instrument at a mid-loop point simply cannot represent the true microbial status near the POU outlet valve.

blocks.zh: USP 法規依據整理
blocks.en: Summary of USP Regulatory Basis

blocks.zh: USP <643>：TOC 測試方法（支援在線監測）
blocks.en: USP <643>: TOC test method (supports online monitoring)

blocks.zh: USP <645>：電導率測試方法（支援在線監測）
blocks.en: USP <645>: Conductivity test method (supports online monitoring)

blocks.zh: USP <1231>：製藥用水指南（微生物 action levels、hold times 等）
blocks.en: USP <1231>: Guidance on water for pharmaceutical purposes (microbial action levels, hold times, etc.)

blocks.zh: FDA 1993 Guide：高純度水系統檢查指南（WFI 微生物行動水準）
blocks.en: FDA 1993 Guide: Guide to Inspections of High Purity Water Systems (WFI microbial action levels)

blocks.zh: 即時放行不適用微生物：法規風險
blocks.en: Real-Time Release Does Not Apply to Microbial Attributes: Regulatory Risk

blocks.zh: 若廠商嘗試以迴路中央在線微生物儀替代 POU grab sampling 用於產品放行，此做法違反目前 USP <1231> 和 FDA 立場——因為：
blocks.en: If a firm tries to use a mid-loop online microbial instrument in place of POU grab sampling for product release, this practice is contrary to current USP <1231> and FDA positions, because:

blocks.zh: 生物膜定位於 POU 附近管路，中央在線儀無法代表
blocks.en: Biofilm is localized in the piping near the POU, which a mid-loop online instrument cannot represent

blocks.zh: POU 測試是法規要求的「release testing」基礎
blocks.en: POU testing is the basis of regulatory "release testing"

blocks.zh: 快速微生物方法（RMM）可替代傳統培養，但仍需從 POU grab sample
blocks.en: Rapid microbiological methods (RMM) can replace traditional culture, but still require a grab sample from the POU

blocks.zh: 思考練習 7
blocks.en: Thinking Exercise 7

blocks.zh: 你的 WFI 系統在主迴路安裝了在線 TOC 和電導率儀器。法規上，這兩個儀器的數據能否直接用於水質放行？前提條件是什麼？
blocks.en: Your WFI system has online TOC and conductivity instruments installed on the main loop. From a regulatory standpoint, can the data from these two instruments be used directly for water release? What are the prerequisites?

blocks.zh: 為什麼在迴路中央安裝在線微生物計數儀，不能取代 POU grab sampling 用於放行？
blocks.en: Why can an online microbial counter installed mid-loop not replace POU grab sampling for release?

blocks.zh: LAL 可攜式快速內毒素測試被 ISPE 認為「接近即時」（near real-time），這對 CDMO 的 WFI 系統放行策略有何影響？
blocks.en: ISPE considers portable rapid LAL endotoxin testing to be "near real-time". What does this mean for a CDMO's WFI release strategy?

blocks.zh: Parametric Release Criteria Table  |  即時放行適用條件表
blocks.en: Parametric Release Criteria Table

blocks.zh: 中文詮釋 & 快速方法策略分析
blocks.en: Commentary & Rapid Method Strategy Analysis

blocks.zh: 快速微生物方法（RMM）的分類邏輯
blocks.en: Classification Logic of Rapid Microbiological Methods (RMM)

blocks.zh: 破壞性 vs. 非破壞性方法
blocks.en: Destructive vs. Non-Destructive Methods

blocks.zh: 破壞性（Destructive）：測試過程殺死細菌細胞。優點：速度快（1-2 小時）。缺點：無法做菌種鑑定（speciation）。適用情境：製程管控（知道有沒有，不需要知道是哪種菌）。
blocks.en: Destructive: The test kills the bacterial cells. Advantage: fast (1-2 hours). Disadvantage: speciation is not possible. Suitable for: process control (knowing whether organisms are present, without needing to know which species).

blocks.zh: 非破壞性（Non-destructive）：不殺死細菌。優點：可進行後續培養和鑑定。缺點：仍需部分培養時間（1-3 天）。適用情境：OOS 調查（需要鑑定菌種）。
blocks.en: Non-destructive: Does not kill the bacteria. Advantage: allows subsequent culture and identification. Disadvantage: still needs some incubation time (1-3 days). Suitable for: OOS investigations (where the species must be identified).

blocks.zh: 比喻：LAL 快速試劑如同「快篩試劑盒」
blocks.en: Analogy: Rapid LAL Reagent Is Like a "Rapid Test Kit"

blocks.zh: 傳統 LAL 需要在實驗室進行，結果要數小時到隔天。可攜式 LAL 試劑盒讓你在現場 15 分鐘得到結果，就像新冠快篩試劑盒——仍需要 grab sample（從 POU 取樣），但結果等待時間大幅縮短，接近「即時放行」。
blocks.en: Traditional LAL must be performed in the laboratory, with results taking several hours to the next day. A portable LAL kit gives a result on site in 15 minutes, much like a COVID rapid test kit: you still need a grab sample (taken from the POU), but the waiting time is greatly shortened, approaching "real-time release".

blocks.zh: CDMO WFI 放行策略建議
blocks.en: CDMO WFI Release Strategy Recommendations

blocks.zh: 目前最優化的 WFI 放行組合策略：
blocks.en: The currently best-optimized combined WFI release strategy:

blocks.zh: 化學屬性（TOC + Conductivity）→ 在線儀器持續監測 + 定期 POU 等效驗證 → 即時放行
blocks.en: Chemical attributes (TOC + conductivity) → continuous monitoring with online instruments + periodic POU equivalence verification → real-time release

blocks.zh: 內毒素 → 可攜式 LAL 從 POU grab sample → 15 分鐘內結果 → 近即時放行
blocks.en: Endotoxin → portable LAL on a POU grab sample → result within 15 minutes → near real-time release

blocks.zh: 微生物 → 快速 RMM（1-2 hr 破壞性）或傳統培養（2-5 天）→ 仍是最慢的瓶頸
blocks.en: Microbial → rapid RMM (1-2 hr, destructive) or traditional culture (2-5 days) → still the slowest bottleneck

blocks.zh: 製造排程需要考慮微生物結果最長等待時間，才能決定「先用水後補結果」的風險管理策略。
blocks.en: Manufacturing scheduling must account for the longest wait for microbial results in order to decide the risk management strategy for "use the water first, complete the results afterwards".

blocks.zh: 「在線生物儀器用於製程管控 vs. 產品放行」的重要區別
blocks.en: The Important Distinction: "Online Bio-Instruments for Process Control vs. Product Release"

blocks.zh: 若在系統中央裝置在線微生物計數儀：
blocks.en: If an online microbial counter is installed in the middle of the system:

blocks.zh: 製程管控（Process Control）：可以用，且有價值——監測趨勢、偵測系統異常
blocks.en: Process control: Can be used, and is valuable: monitoring trends and detecting system anomalies

blocks.zh: 產品放行（Product Release）：不能用——因為數據不能代表 POU 水質
blocks.en: Product release: Cannot be used, because the data cannot represent POU water quality

blocks.zh: 這個區別在法規審查中非常關鍵，不可混淆。
blocks.en: This distinction is critical in regulatory review and must not be confused.

blocks.zh: 思考練習 8
blocks.en: Thinking Exercise 8

blocks.zh: 你的 WFI 系統想導入在線 ATP 生物發光法（online bioluminescence）偵測微生物。依照 ISPE 2016，這個數據可以用於哪些目的？哪些目的不行？
blocks.en: Your WFI system wants to introduce online ATP bioluminescence to detect microorganisms. According to ISPE 2016, for which purposes can this data be used, and for which can it not?

blocks.zh: 可攜式 LAL 試劑盒能在 15 分鐘給出內毒素結果。如果你的製程需要 WFI 使用前確認內毒素合格，這個方法在排程上有何優勢？
blocks.en: A portable LAL kit can give an endotoxin result in 15 minutes. If your process requires confirmation that WFI meets endotoxin requirements before use, what scheduling advantage does this method offer?

blocks.zh: 未來若某種即時在線微生物技術被 USP 認可，可以從 POU 直接讀取並用於放行，需要什麼樣的驗證工作才能達到這個目標？
blocks.en: If, in future, a real-time online microbial technology is recognized by USP so that it can read directly from the POU and be used for release, what validation work would be required to achieve this?

blocks.zh: Chapter 2.7 Summary — Key Takeaways for Real-Time Release  |  即時放行關鍵重點總結
blocks.en: Chapter 2.7 Summary: Key Takeaways for Real-Time Release

blocks.zh: Section Review & Integration  |  章節整合複習
blocks.en: Section Review & Integration

blocks.zh: Cross-section connections and practical application for CDMO QC labs  |  跨節連結與 CDMO 實驗室應用
blocks.en: Cross-section connections and practical application for CDMO QC labs

blocks.zh: CDMO 實驗室整合應用清單
blocks.en: CDMO Laboratory Integrated Application Checklist

blocks.zh: 閥門與系統審查（2.4）
blocks.en: Valve and System Review (2.4)

blocks.zh: 確認所有 WFI/PW POU 閥門為衛生隔膜閥，有 sanitary clamp 連接
blocks.en: Confirm that all WFI/PW POU valves are sanitary diaphragm valves with sanitary clamp connections

blocks.zh: 確認閥門出口朝下，可自然排水
blocks.en: Confirm that valve outlets face downward for natural drainage

blocks.zh: 高溫 WFI 系統確認把手材質（非不鏽鋼）
blocks.en: For hot WFI systems, confirm the handle material (not stainless steel)

blocks.zh: 新閥門安裝前先採購樣本測試排水特性
blocks.en: Before installing a new valve, procure a sample first and test its drainage characteristics

blocks.zh: 取樣程序審查（2.5）
blocks.en: Sampling Procedure Review (2.5)

blocks.zh: SOP 明定正確取樣順序（化學先，微生物後）
blocks.en: SOP clearly specifies the correct sampling order (chemical first, microbial last)

blocks.zh: 容器清單與每種屬性的容器規格書
blocks.en: Container list and a container specification for each attribute

blocks.zh: 取樣員訓練記錄 + 定期技術評審
blocks.en: Sampler training records + periodic technique review

blocks.zh: 軟管使用程序：安裝時間、最長留置時間、拆除記錄
blocks.en: Hose use procedure: installation time, maximum time in place, removal record

blocks.zh: 樣品管理審查（2.6）
blocks.en: Sample Management Review (2.6)

blocks.zh: 建立各屬性的 hold time 規格表（嵌入 SOP）
blocks.en: Establish a hold time specification table for each attribute (embedded in the SOP)

blocks.zh: 樣品標籤含取樣時間（精確到分鐘）
blocks.en: Sample labels include the sampling time (to the minute)

blocks.zh: Chain of Custody 表格涵蓋所有轉移節點
blocks.en: Chain of Custody form covers all transfer points

blocks.zh: 實驗室接收確認程序（時間、溫度驗證）
blocks.en: Laboratory receipt confirmation procedure (time and temperature verification)

blocks.zh: 冷鏈運輸使用無水冷袋，禁用冰水
blocks.en: Use waterless cold packs for cold chain transport; do not use ice water

blocks.zh: 放行策略審查（2.7）
blocks.en: Release Strategy Review (2.7)

blocks.zh: 確認在線 TOC / 電導率儀器已完成 POU 等效驗證
blocks.en: Confirm that online TOC / conductivity instruments have completed POU equivalence validation

blocks.zh: 微生物放行仍依賴 POU grab sample——不可被在線儀器替代
blocks.en: Microbial release still depends on POU grab samples and cannot be replaced by online instruments

blocks.zh: 考慮導入可攜式 LAL 快速內毒素測試縮短放行時間
blocks.en: Consider introducing portable rapid LAL endotoxin testing to shorten release time

blocks.zh: 評估 RMM 方法作為微生物快速放行策略
blocks.en: Evaluate RMM methods as a rapid microbial release strategy
